quests.instruction: Sam left his jacket at school and now it's cold at pick-up time. What should he do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a teacher and look in the lost property box 🔍
options: Wait outside in the cold until it warms up 🥶
Wear a classmate's coat without asking 🧥
Tell a teacher and look in the lost property box 🔍
quests.hint: Someone at school can help.
quests.explanation: Telling an adult is the quickest way to find the jacket or get a warm layer.
quests.funFact: Writing your name inside your jacket helps it get returned.

quests.instruction: Rain begins suddenly while Aisha is at the park without a raincoat. What is the safest, driest choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Go to a covered place or a nearby building 🏠
options: Keep playing on the open grass 🌧️
Stand under a tall tree in the rain 🌳
Go to a covered place or a nearby building 🏠
quests.hint: Look for a place that blocks rain.
quests.explanation: A covered place keeps her dry. A wet shirt will make her cold.
quests.funFact: If thunder is heard, indoors is much safer than staying out in the open.

quests.instruction: Lina's shoelace snaps on the way to school. What is a sensible fix?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask an adult for a new lace or a knot 🪢
options: Run with the shoe flopping open 🏃
Ask an adult for a new lace or a knot 🪢
Walk with one shoe in her hand 🦶
quests.hint: The shoe needs to stay snug.
quests.explanation: A new lace or a secure knot keeps the shoe on her foot so she doesn't trip.
quests.funFact: Spare laces are cheap and easy to keep in a bag.

quests.instruction: Ravi's hands are freezing and he has forgotten his gloves. What can help right away?
quests.correctAnswer: Tuck his hands into his sleeves or pockets 🧥
options: Hold his hands under cold running water 💧
Tuck his hands into his sleeves or pockets 🧥
Rub his hands together with wet snow ❄️
quests.hint: Warmth comes from keeping heat in.
quests.explanation: Sleeves and pockets trap heat near the hands and shelter them from wind.
quests.funFact: Hands are cooler than the body core because they are far from the heart.

quests.instruction: Priya's fingers sting after a snowball fight. What should she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Go inside and warm her hands slowly 🏠
options: Go inside and warm her hands slowly 🏠
Put them under very hot water 🔥
Stay out longer 🥶
quests.hint: Sudden heat can hurt cold skin.
quests.explanation: Slow warming is gentle. Very hot water can hurt cold fingers.
quests.funFact: Cold fingers can feel pins and needles as they warm up.

quests.instruction: Which plan makes cold hands less likely during a long walk in snow?
quests.correctAnswer: Thin gloves under mittens 🧤
options: Bare hands in pockets 👖
Thin gloves under mittens 🧤
Wet gloves 💦
quests.hint: Two layers help.
quests.explanation: Gloves under mittens add an extra layer and keep hands warm even if the mittens come off.
quests.funFact: Mittens keep fingers together so they share warmth.

quests.instruction: Noor's new shirt feels too tight under the arms. What should she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell an adult and try a bigger size 🗣️
options: Tell an adult and try a bigger size 🗣️
Wear it anyway and say nothing 😖
Cut the seams to make it stretch ✂️
quests.hint: Tight clothes can cause pain or rubbing.
quests.explanation: A shirt that pinches needs a different size so she can move comfortably.
quests.funFact: Sizes vary between brands.

quests.instruction: Kofi's sock keeps bunching up inside his shoe. What would solve the problem?
quests.correctAnswer: Pull the sock smooth or use socks that fit better 🧦
options: Wear a thicker shoe over the bunch 👟
Add a second sock to flatten it 🧦
Pull the sock smooth or use socks that fit better 🧦
quests.hint: Bunches rub the skin.
quests.explanation: A sock lying flat won't rub, and a better-fitting sock stays in place.
quests.funFact: Bunched socks are a common cause of blisters.

quests.instruction: The zipper on Jo's jacket is stuck halfway. What should she do first?
quests.correctAnswer: Wiggle it gently and ask for help if stuck 🤐
options: Yank it up as hard as she can 💪
Cut the fabric around the zipper ✂️
Wiggle it gently and ask for help if stuck 🤐
quests.hint: Forcing can break it.
quests.explanation: Gentle wiggling frees many stuck zippers, and an adult can help with the rest.
quests.funFact: A zipper can get stuck if fabric gets caught in its teeth.

quests.instruction: Ben has grass stains on his knees after a ball game. What should happen to his pants?
quests.correctAnswer: Go into the wash, and treat the stains soon 🫧
options: Go into the wash, and treat the stains soon 🫧
Be left on the floor to dry 🧹
Go back into the drawer until next week 🗄️
quests.hint: Stains are easier to remove early.
quests.explanation: Washing soon helps lift the stain before it sets.
quests.funFact: Grass stains come from plant pigments.

quests.instruction: Mud splashes onto Zoe's sleeves just before lunch. What is the best quick fix?
quests.correctAnswer: Wipe off loose mud, wash hands, and change if she can 🧼
options: Wipe muddy hands on her sleeves 👕
Wipe off loose mud, wash hands, and change if she can 🧼
Eat lunch with muddy hands and sleeves 🍽️
quests.hint: Think about clean hands and clean clothes.
quests.explanation: Wiping off loose mud and washing hands keeps dirt away from food.
quests.funFact: Always wash hands before eating.

quests.instruction: Why is it better to rinse a muddy shirt before putting it with other laundry?
quests.correctAnswer: Mud can spread dirt onto other clothes 🧺
options: Mud always shrinks the shirt in the wash 📉
Mud can spread dirt onto other clothes 🧺
Mud washes out faster once it dries 🪨
quests.hint: Consider what happens in the basket.
quests.explanation: Rinsing off mud first keeps other laundry from getting dirty.
quests.funFact: Mud is made of tiny bits of soil and water.

quests.instruction: Priya wore sandals, but the trail is rocky and her toes hurt. What is the smartest response?
quests.correctAnswer: Stop, tell the adult, and wear closed shoes next time 🥾
options: Stop, tell the adult, and wear closed shoes next time 🥾
Take the sandals off and walk barefoot 🦶
Keep going faster and ignore the pain 🏃
quests.hint: The shoes did not match the ground.
quests.explanation: Closed shoes protect toes on rocky ground. Telling an adult helps solve the problem.
quests.funFact: Hiking shoes have sturdy soles for uneven ground.

quests.instruction: Zoe's raincoat lets water in at the seams. What can she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask an adult about waterproofing or a replacement 🧥
options: Wear it over a wet sweater 💧
Wear it inside out to hide the seams 🔄
Ask an adult about waterproofing or a replacement 🧥
quests.hint: The coat isn't doing its job.
quests.explanation: Seams can wear out. Special spray or a new coat can restore dryness.
quests.funFact: Rain jackets lose water resistance as they age.

quests.instruction: Yuki's winter boots are warm, but her feet get very sweaty inside. What will help?
quests.correctAnswer: Switch to dry, moisture-wicking socks 🧦
options: Cover her feet with plastic bags 🛍️
Wear tighter boots to squeeze sweat out 😖
Switch to dry, moisture-wicking socks 🧦
quests.hint: Moisture is the issue.
quests.explanation: Moisture-wicking socks pull sweat away and keep feet drier and warmer.
quests.funFact: Damp feet get cold faster.

quests.instruction: Ravi forgot his gym shoes on PE day. What is a responsible choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell the teacher and ask what to do 🗣️
options: Do the lesson in socks only 🧦
Tell the teacher and ask what to do 🗣️
Skip the lesson and hide in the toilets 🚪
quests.hint: Teachers can help.
quests.explanation: The teacher can suggest a safe option, like a spare pair.
quests.funFact: Socks alone can be slippery on gym floors.

quests.instruction: Mei forgot her sun hat on a bright day at the pool. What helps protect her?
quests.correctAnswer: Stay in shade, wear a light shirt, use sunscreen 🌞
options: Sit in full sun to get used to it ☀️
Do nothing and hope for clouds 🙈
Stay in shade, wear a light shirt, use sunscreen 🌞
quests.hint: Think of other ways to shade skin.
quests.explanation: Shade, clothes, and sunscreen can protect skin when a hat isn't available.
quests.funFact: Sunburn can happen in less than an hour on a sunny day.

quests.instruction: Aisha packs a 'just in case' bag for a school trip. Which items make the most sense?
quests.correctAnswer: Spare socks, a light jacket, and a hat 🎒
options: Spare socks, a light jacket, and a hat 🎒
One heavy pair of boots and a scarf 🥾
Three swimsuits and a pair of flip-flops 🩱
quests.hint: Think about common surprises.
quests.explanation: Spare socks, a light jacket, and a hat cover surprise rain, cool air, or sun.
quests.funFact: Packing flexible items saves space.

quests.instruction: Kai's long scarf is trailing near a moving escalator. What should he do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tuck it in or hold it up 🧣
options: Let it drag 🚶
Tie it to his shoe 🪢
Tuck it in or hold it up 🧣
quests.hint: Loose cloth can get caught.
quests.explanation: Tucked scarves can't get caught in moving steps.
quests.funFact: Escalators have signs about loose clothing.

quests.instruction: Tariq's hood is up and blocks his side view at a busy crossing. What should he do?
quests.correctAnswer: Pull it down so he can see and hear traffic 🚦
options: Keep it up so rain stays off his face 🌧️
Pull it tighter so nothing distracts him 🧥
Pull it down so he can see and hear traffic 🚦
quests.hint: What does a hood take away from the side view?
quests.explanation: He needs to see and hear cars, so lowering the hood helps.
quests.funFact: Hoods can reduce side vision.

quests.instruction: Why are loose flip-flops a poor choice for running for a bus?
quests.correctAnswer: They can slip off and make you trip 🩴
options: They can slip off and make you trip 🩴
They are too hot for running outdoors 🔥
They are too noisy on the pavement 🔊
quests.hint: Think about quick movement.
quests.explanation: Flip-flops don't hold the foot firmly, so running can send you tumbling.
quests.funFact: Closed shoes protect toes from stubbing.

quests.instruction: A grown-up washed Mei's wool sweater in hot water, and it shrank. What is the lesson?
quests.correctAnswer: Check the care label before washing 🏷️
options: Wash everything in hot water 🌡️
Check the care label before washing 🏷️
Never wash anything 🚫
quests.hint: The label has answers.
quests.explanation: Care labels tell you the right temperature and method.
quests.funFact: Wool fibers can tangle and shrink with heat and rubbing.

quests.instruction: A shirt's tag says 'do not tumble dry.' What should happen after washing?
quests.correctAnswer: Air-dry it 🌬️
options: Air-dry it 🌬️
Iron it while wet ⚡
Put it in the dryer ♨️
quests.hint: Follow the tag.
quests.explanation: Air drying avoids heat that can shrink or damage the fabric.
quests.funFact: Hang drying also saves energy.

quests.instruction: Boots smell musty after a whole snowy season. What helps?
quests.correctAnswer: Air them out and use dry socks 🧦
options: Seal them in a bag for the summer 🛍️
Wear them wet so they stay warm 💦
Air them out and use dry socks 🧦
quests.hint: Moisture and smell.
quests.explanation: Airing lets moisture escape and dry socks reduce smell.
quests.funFact: Bacteria love damp places.

quests.instruction: A classmate's pants got soaked in a spill and she looks upset. What is a kind choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a teacher so she can get dry clothes 🙋
options: Tell a teacher so she can get dry clothes 🙋
Point it out to the whole class 📢
Walk away and say nothing 🙈
quests.hint: Remember how you'd want help.
quests.explanation: A teacher can help find dry clothes so she feels comfortable again.
quests.funFact: Kind words and quick help make accidents easier.

quests.instruction: Kofi's jacket is too small, but it is clean and warm. What good use can he make of it?
quests.correctAnswer: Pass it on to someone who could use it 🎁
options: Throw it away in the bin 🗑️
Pass it on to someone who could use it 🎁
Wear it even though it is too tight 😖
quests.hint: Clothes can have a second life.
quests.explanation: Passing on outgrown clothes helps someone else and avoids waste.
quests.funFact: Many schools and communities have clothing swaps.

quests.instruction: Sana notices a child at school without gloves on a freezing day. What could she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a teacher so they can help 🙋
options: Tell a teacher so they can help 🙋
Keep your own gloves and stay quiet 🧤
Walk past and say nothing 🤐
quests.hint: Adults can help.
quests.explanation: A teacher can find gloves or a warm place so he isn't cold.
quests.funFact: Schools often have spare gloves and hats.

quests.instruction: The zipper on Ravi's winter jacket is broken. What is the best way to stay warm until it is fixed?
quests.correctAnswer: Wear a snug sweater underneath and get it repaired 🧥
options: Wear a snug sweater underneath and get it repaired 🧥
Leave the jacket open and walk fast 🥶
Go outside without any jacket 🚪
quests.hint: Cover the gap and fix it.
quests.explanation: A sweater provides extra warmth under the open jacket until someone can repair the zipper.
quests.funFact: Zippers can sometimes be repaired by replacing the slider.

quests.instruction: Tom lost one glove on the way to school. What can he do to keep that hand warm now?
quests.correctAnswer: Tuck it into a pocket or sleeve 🧥
options: Wet it 💧
Tuck it into a pocket or sleeve 🧥
Leave it bare in the wind 🌬️
quests.hint: Use what he has.
quests.explanation: A pocket or sleeve shields the hand from wind and holds heat.
quests.funFact: Mittens on a string help prevent losing one.

quests.instruction: Which habit helps prevent many clothing problems?
quests.correctAnswer: Check the weather and your bag before leaving 🎒
options: Wear the same clothes every day 👕
Check the weather and your bag before leaving 🎒
Ignore the forecast and hope for the best 🙈
quests.hint: What could you do before you leave the house?
quests.explanation: Checking the weather and your bag helps you pack the right layers.
quests.funFact: Looking at the sky before leaving is also helpful.
